items.prompt: Capacity 2 has A:1, B:2. PUT A 4 is followed by PUT C 3. Which key is evicted?

options.text: A, because its original insertion was earliest.
options.why: Updating A refreshes it to MRU under this task.

options.text: B, because updating A does not grow key count but does refresh recency.
options.why: After PUT A 4 the order is B,A; adding C therefore evicts B.

options.text: Both A and B, because a write always empties the cache.
options.why: Only one overflow entry is removed; updates do not clear other live keys.

options.text: No key, because writes never enforce capacity.
options.why: The third distinct key requires eviction at capacity 2.

items.explanation: After PUT A 4 the order is B,A; adding C therefore evicts B.
